notes: The pre-rnull baseline already exposes core blk-mq structs, request_queue, gendisk, and generic time helpers.
The baseline did not include configfs, badblocks, or hrtimer headers in rust/bindings/bindings_helper.h.
The baseline blk-mq Rust abstraction is too small for null_blk semantics even when the raw C structs exist in generated bindings.

binding_inputs_added_to_bindings_helper_.reason: Needed for queue_limits, request_queue fields, write-cache controls, and blk block-size/queue helpers.
Needed for configfs_subsystem, config_group, config_item, config_item_type, and callback vtables.
Needed for badblocks state and badblocks_{init,show,set,clear,check,exit} APIs.
Needed for hrtimer struct, hrtimer_restart enum, hrtimer_active/cancel/init/start/forward APIs, and timer mode constants.

additional_headers_reserved_for_follow_u.reason: Needed only if the abstraction layer uses generic page-copy helper bridges for request segment I/O.

required_symbol_groups.planned_rust_abstraction: driver-owned typed wrapper over bindings inside rust/kernel/block abstractions and rnull support code

required_symbol_groups.status: partially direct; inline coverage still needs verification
struct fields covered; Rust wrapper gap remains
header-level availability depends on bindgen inline coverage; helper bridge likely still required

gaps_that_cannot_be_solved_by_more_bindg.why: The bindings expose raw pointers only; the required ownership model must be encoded in Rust wrappers.
The baseline Request wrapper only models end_ok and lacks the status-carrying completion paths needed by null_blk.
Direct bindings do not provide a driver-safe pinned timer interface.

next_actions: Front-port the minimal configfs abstraction into rust/kernel/configfs.rs.
Extend rust/kernel/block/mq to expose queue data, hctx data, completion, timeout, poll, map_queues, and request metadata safely.
Add a minimal hrtimer abstraction in rust/kernel/time/hrtimer.rs, using helper bridges only where inline functions block direct Rust use.
